sections.title: 4. Generated Concepts, AI Safety, and Disclaimer

blocks.text: Nature of AI Outputs

Visualizations, concepts, renders, and text recommendations (including Briller's Architectural Insights covering Materials & Composition, Lighting & Ambiance, and Installation & Engineering Notes) are automatically generated by AI models.
Non-Professional Advice Disclaimer

AI outputs may contain inaccurate spatial dimensions, altered geometry, unsuitable products, or non-viable structural suggestions. They do not constitute approved construction documents, blueprinted structural calculations, or professional architectural, engineering, electrical, or legal advice.
Verification Obligation

You must verify all room dimensions, structural features, material specifications, safety considerations, and municipal building codes with qualified professional architects, structural engineers, or licensed contractors before purchasing products, issuing documentation, or executing physical construction or renovation work.
Briller offers various subscription plans and credit structures within the App.
Pricing Reference

Detailed parameters regarding current subscription tiers (including Free, Explorer, Pro Design, and Studio / Architect), monthly/annual prices, included iteration quotas, active project limits, and features are published on our Pricing page (briller.house/pricing) and match the checkout experience inside the App.
Payment Processing
Billing and subscription management are conducted securely in-app via Stripe (utilizing Stripe Payment Element / Embedded Checkout).
Recurring Billing & Renewal Notice

Paid plans automatically renew at the end of each billing cycle (monthly or annually) unless canceled prior to the renewal date. Stripe notifies users of upcoming charges as required by applicable payment regulations.
Taxes
Stated prices may be exclusive of applicable VAT or sales taxes, which will be calculated and displayed at Stripe checkout based on your geographic location.
Plan & Price Modifications
Briller reserves the right to adjust subscription prices, credit quotas, or feature sets upon advance notice sent via email or displayed within the App.
Cancellation

You may cancel your subscription at any time via the billing dashboard or Stripe Customer Portal. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current paid billing period; you retain access to paid plan limits until that date.
Iteration Metering
Generating an initial AI concept or executing a refinement step consumes credits according to the rules specified in your plan.
Subscription Credits
Monthly plan credits replenish at the start of each billing period and expire at the end of the billing cycle (no rollover).
Top-Up Credits
Users may purchase additional non-expiring credit packs as detailed on the Pricing page (briller.house/pricing).
Order of Deduction
Credits are consumed according to system priority: (1) Free Monthly Allowance → (2) Subscription Credits → (3) Top-Up Credits.
Operation Costs & Failed Deductions
Credits are deducted upon initiating a generation request. If a system failure or network fault causes a generation error, the credit is either not deducted or automatically restored.
UI Deletions & Unused Credits on Cancellation

Deleting an iteration card or project from your workspace does not restore consumed credits, as computing resources were already expended. Unused non-expiring Top-Up credits remain saved on your account balance for future use, even if a recurring subscription is canceled.

sections.title: 4. Створені концепції, безпека AI та застереження

blocks.text: Природа AI-результатів

Візуалізації, концепції, рендери й текстові рекомендації, зокрема архітектурні поради Briller щодо матеріалів і композиції, освітлення й атмосфери, монтажу та інженерних рішень, автоматично створюються AI-моделями.

AI-результати можуть містити неточні розміри, змінену геометрію, непридатні товари або нездійсненні конструктивні пропозиції. Вони не є затвердженою будівельною документацією, оформленими конструктивними розрахунками чи професійною архітектурною, інженерною, електротехнічною або юридичною консультацією.
Обов’язок перевірки

Перед придбанням товарів, видачею документації або виконанням будівельних чи ремонтних робіт ви повинні перевірити всі розміри приміщення, конструктивні особливості, специфікації матеріалів, вимоги безпеки та місцеві будівельні норми з кваліфікованими архітекторами, інженерами-конструкторами або ліцензованими підрядниками.
